profile.ja: 主に前線での戦闘任務を担当する対魔忍。任務以外ではボーッとしている事が多く、戦闘訓練などでも目立ったところはない。だが、いざ戦闘となると忍法の特性を生かし、驚く程執念深い戦いを見せる。そのギャップからか親しく付き合う友人などもおらず、基本的には一人で居る事が多い。ただ、決して人嫌いなわけではなく、仲間意識も強いタイプで、ただ口べたなだけである。その為に仲間を傷つける者を激しく敵視し、一切の容赦を見せない。なお、非常に質素な生活を送っていて趣味等もこれといってないが、餌付けした野鳥と戯れるのを日課としている
profile.en: (Yuri Hisui, she/her) She is a Taimanin primarily assigned to frontline combat missions. Outside of missions she often zones out and doesn't stand out during combat training. Yet when battle begins, she leverages the unique traits of her ninjutsu to fight with astonishing tenacity. Because of this stark contrast, she has no close friends and usually spends time alone. That isn't because she dislikes people; she simply has a strong sense of camaraderie and is just a bit outspoken. Consequently, she harbors a fierce hatred for anyone who harms her comrades and shows no mercy. She leads a very modest lifestyle with no particular hobbies, but she makes it a daily habit to play with the wild birds she feeds.

text.ja: 「対魔忍、由利翡翠……それだけって……？　うん、よろしく」
text.en: "Taimanin, Yuri Hisui… that's all? Yeah, nice to meet you."

text.ja: ……ん、なにか用かと思って。別にないの？　そう……
text.en: "…Hmm, I thought you had something for me. Nothing? I see…"

text.ja: 提案をして貰って悪いけど……全然興味ないの
text.en: "Sorry for the suggestion, but I'm really not interested at all."

text.ja: 特に話す必要が無いと思っただけで、嫌がってはないから安心して
text.en: "I just thought there was no need to talk, but I'm not refusing, so don't worry."

text.ja: よく趣味とか好きな物を聞かれるけど、特にない……あ、でも動物は可愛くて好きかな
text.en: "People often ask about my hobbies or likes, but I don't really have any… Ah, but I do think animals are cute."

text.ja: その、別に人が嫌いなわけじゃない……むしろ皆大事だと思ってるんだけど……
text.en: "It's not that I dislike people… Actually I think everyone is important…"

text.ja: 対魔忍、由利翡翠。仲間は絶対に守るから、安心して
text.en: "Taimanin, Yuri Hisui. I'll absolutely protect my comrades, so rest assured."

text.ja: 私の合食の術は効果が出るまで遅いけど、粘り強さが売りだから……うん
text.en: "My combined-food technique takes a while to kick in, but persistence is my strength… yeah."
